name: OASIS-3: Longitudinal Neuroimaging, Clinical, and Cognitive Dataset
description: OASIS-3 is the third release in the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS), compiled by the Knight Alzheimer Disease Research Center (ADRC) at Washington University School of Medicine. The dataset is a longitudinal neuroimaging, clinical, cognitive, and biomarker resource for normal aging and Alzheimer's disease. Spanning over 30 years of observation, OASIS-3 contains data from 1,098 adult participants (aged 42–95) across 2,168 MR imaging sessions (T1w, T2w, FLAIR, DTI, resting-state fMRI, ASL) and 1,608 PET sessions (PIB, AV45, AV1451). Scans are mapped alongside clinical dementia rating (CDR) scores, neuropsychological test batteries, post-mortem neuropathology, and APOE genotype. Access is free upon signing the OASIS Data Use Agreement on central.xnat.org.
